findings.description: find() returns the exact list object stored in the cache, both on a hit (line 63) and on a miss (line 68). If a caller sorts, appends to or removes from the returned list, the cached entry is corrupted. Later callers with the same query get the altered results until the TTL expires or a product is added. Before this change each call returned a fresh list, so callers could mutate it safely.
findings.suggestion: Store a tuple internally and return list(entry[1]) on hits and list(hits) on misses, so callers never hold the cached list.
findings.title: Cached result list is returned by reference and can be mutated by callers
